description: Apply an Image > Adjustments command to pixel layers (inside the selection, if there is one). This changes the pixels; it does not add an adjustment layer. auto_color_correction applies Auto with an algorithm from Auto Color Correction Options, once; match_color adjusts the layer on its own (Match Color with Source: None, RGB only); replace_color changes one colour and the colours within its fuzziness (Replace Color). Options by type: brightness_contrast (brightness, contrast, useLegacy); levels (inputBlack, inputWhite, gamma, outputBlack, outputWhite, channel, auto); curves (points, channel); color_balance (shadows, midtones, highlights, preserveLuminosity); photo_filter (color, density, preserveLuminosity, filter); shadows_highlights (shadowAmount, highlightAmount, shadowWidth, highlightWidth, shadowRadius, highlightRadius, colorCorrection, midtoneContrast, blackClip, whiteClip); posterize (levels); threshold (level); desaturate; invert; equalize; auto_levels; auto_contrast; auto_color; auto_color_correction (algorithm, snapNeutralMidtones); match_color (luminance, colorIntensity, fade, neutralize); replace_color (color, fuzziness, hue, saturation, lightness); exposure (exposure, offset, gamma); vibrance (vibrance, saturation); hue_saturation (hue, saturation, lightness, colorize, ranges); black_and_white (reds, yellows, greens, cyans, blues, magentas, tint, tintColor); channel_mixer (monochrome, red, green, blue, gray); selective_color (method, reds, yellows, greens, cyans, blues, magentas, whites, neutrals, blacks); gradient_map (gradient, reverse, dither, method)

options.description: Settings for the chosen type; omitted settings use the defaults Photoshop opens its dialog with

target.description: Pixel layers. Default the active layer

names.description: Layer names (every layer with each name)

name: adjust_layers
title: Adjust Layers
